agentUsage.purpose: Browse and fuzzy-search files in a directory tree, copy paths to clipboard. V3.y.1: clicking a file result now opens it in the file-edits applet (which routes to the appropriate viewer — markdown / image / html / diff) instead of the standalone single-purpose applets.
